inicio.avanzadasTexto: The project trained 5 artificial intelligence models. The most accurate one is used by default; here you can choose another one or compare all 5 on the same photo.
inicio.comparar: Compare the 5 models on this photo
inicio.comoFuncionaTexto: The models were trained with grain photos from the Rice Image Dataset (Koklu et al., 75,000 images) and evaluated on 11,206 photos they never saw during training: all of them are more than 99% accurate. Your photo is not stored; it is only used to classify it.
inicio.pie: Artificial Intelligence course project · Julian Delgado and Cesar Camilo Hoyos Diaz

variedades.ARBORIO: Italian short, rounded grain variety with a lot of starch. It is the typical rice for risotto.
variedades.BASMATI: Aromatic long, slender grain rice, grown mainly in India and Pakistan. It lengthens when cooked and stays loose.
variedades.IPSALA: Variety from Turkey, grown in the Ipsala area (Edirne province), in the northwest of the country.
variedades.JASMINE: Aromatic long grain rice from Thailand. When cooked it is soft and slightly sticky.
variedades.KARACADAG: Local variety from southeastern Turkey, from the area of Mount Karacadağ (Diyarbakır).

clasificador.metricasExplicacion: Results on the project's 11,206 test photos. The weight is how much each model counts when all 5 vote together.
clasificador.avisoPrueba: Untrained test models are in use: the predictions are not real.
